headline: Genome foundation models pretrained with phylogeny, gene, and diffusion objectives
label: Deep Learning Sequence Models
summary: Pretraining strategies that encode evolutionary structure and genomic context are being tested on plant, microbial, and promoter DNA tasks.
synthesis: The common thread is injecting biological structure into genomic foundation model pretraining and architecture. Creator 1.0 scales a 2B-parameter plant genome model across 1,000 genomes using phylogeny-guided stagewise pretraining, and reports first-place ranking on GENEB plant benchmarks. VenusGenome keeps a masked autoencoding framework but adds genome-aware attention over contig boundaries, strand, and gene position, pretrained on 1.7M microbial genomes at gene resolution. DAPE-PD takes a different route: it adapts the autoregressive Evo model into a bidirectional masked diffusion model for generating functional promoter DNA. Across these items, the new element is conditioning pretraining or generation on evolutionary relationships, genomic coordinates, or design targets rather than on sequence alone.
